messages:
maria_support: FYI ticket #3452 from ACME (acme-prod) — seeing sustained 429s on /v1/generate. Customer is on Dedicated (pool: gdx-gold-1) and says capacity is available, but requests are being routed to shared-small and throttled. Trace id: tr_20240728_01. Can eng-runtime take a look? :rotating_light:

jess_eng: Looking. Do we have the router logs for that trace id? Also which header are they sending for tier — x-customer-tier or x-tenant-tier?

maria_support: They send x-customer-tier: Gold (capital G). Customer says they configured reserved capacity for 'gold' tier. Pasting anonymized router log snippet below:

```
[router] time=2024-07-28T14:07:03Z trace=tr_20240728_01 tenant=acme-prod header_x_customer_tier=Gold selected_pool=shared-small policy_match=tier_map_v2
```

alex_runtime_oncall: Quick glance — routing matched policy 'tier_map_v2' but chose 'shared-small' because the control-plane policy store has keys lowercased (gold) while the header parser currently preserves case (Gold). Our new header parsing change stopped normalizing values, so case mismatch caused no exact key hit and fallback went to shared pool.

jess_eng: Wait — policy keys are supposed to be normalized on ingestion. Did the control-plane deploy last night change normalization? @alex_runtime_oncall any known deploys?

alex_runtime_oncall: Yes — we rolled CR-2311 last night to optimize header parsing performance. The change accidentally removed a lowercase() call for legacy tier mappings. Repro steps I used:

1) curl -H "x-customer-tier: Gold" https://router.local/v1/generate -> pool=shared-small
2) curl -H "x-customer-tier: gold" https://router.local/v1/generate -> pool=gdx-gold-1

So case sensitivity is the root cause. :facepalm:

karim_support_lead: Impact looks high for any customers who set tier values with capitalization. Can we hotfix? Temporary mitigations?

alex_runtime_oncall: I'll apply a temporary tenant-level override for acme-prod to force pool=gdx-gold-1. Also preparing a rollback PR to revert CR-2311 normalization removal. Applying override now.

sre-bot: deploy started: rollback CR-2311 (pr/2316) by alex_runtime_oncall — estimated completion 6m.

alex_runtime_oncall: Rollback applied. Re-checking trace: router log now shows:

```
[router] time=2024-07-28T14:09:21Z trace=tr_20240728_01 tenant=acme-prod header_x_customer_tier=Gold selected_pool=gdx-gold-1 policy_match=tier_map_v2
```

maria_support: Confirmed with customer — 429s dropped immediately after our change, latency back to normal. Customer says service is stable for now. I'll update ticket #3452 and close the escalation for now.

jess_eng: I'll open a tracking issue to make this permanent: ensure policy ingestion always normalizes keys and add unit/integration tests for header value casing. Filing GH issue #7890.

alex_runtime_oncall: Thanks — I'll attach the repro script and test vectors to #7890, and add a canary job to cover header-case variations. Action items: rollback CR-2311 (done), tenant override (torn down in 24h), GH#7890 created, postmortem planned.

karim_support_lead: Excellent. Please ping me when postmortem draft is ready. :thumbsup:
